Isodrimeninol is directly linked to Cyclin-dependent kinase 7 (CDK7), which is a target of Bakuchalcone. Bakuchalcone, in turn, is a target of EGFR. This indicates a chain of interactions where Isodrimeninol may influence CDK7, which then affects Bakuchalcone, ultimately leading to EGFR activation. The scores provided suggest a moderate level of confidence in this pathway, though the exact nature of the interaction between Isodrimeninol and EGFR remains unclear. The evidence supports a possible indirect pathway, but further experimental validation is needed to confirm the direct involvement of Isodrimeninol in EGFR regulation.
